Caliente Noshos -- Crispy chips smothered in melted cheese, beans and jalapenos. A good sized order that's shareable. Nachos never had it so good.

Queso Con Hongos - Fresh mushrooms sauteed with onions and "salsa verde", layered with creamy melted cheese served with warm tortillas.
Quesadilla - plenty of cheese, tomatoes, green peppers and scallions wrapped in a large flour tortilla then grilled.
Camarones Al Mojo De Ajo -- Tender shrimps sauteed with fresh garlic. WHEW!
Alitas De Pollo "Caliente" --A hefty portion of chicken wings marinated in a red hot "caliente" sauce. This is a good appetizer for one big appetite -- two regular appetites or three who eat like birds.
Chili Con Cab Co. -- It's a crock!!
Guacamole -- Cool and Creamy.
Tostaco Salad - A giant crisp flour tortilla topped with a generous helping of warm taco beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, diced tomatoes and refried beans topped with guacamole and sour cream
Pozole - Each day we simmer what seems like tons of chicken for our enchiladas, etc. To the resulting broth we add a medley of fresh vegetables which make this dish the best cold remedy you can get without a prescription
Ensalada De Camarones - Baby shrimps tossed in a creamy tomato dressing garnished with avocado chunks, lettuce and tomato slices,  Rice and Beans
Sopa De Frijol Negro - The classic hearty black bean soup garnished with strips of crisp tortillas and sour cream
Ensalada De Pollo y Aguacate - Tender chunks of chicken, avocados, tomatoes and shredded cheese served in a crisp tostada "bowl"
Pollo Adobado - Plump, juicy, half chicken. First marinated in a special sauce, then charbroiled. Served with rice and pico de gallo
Steak Tampiquena - A tender slab of charbroiled steak marinated in our own special way - served with a cheese enchilada, "caliente" rice and pico de gallo
Chiles Rellenos De Elote - Poblano peppers stuffed with corn then baked with cheese and sour cream served on a bed of rice
Camarones Chipotle - Chipotle chilies add their unique flavor and tang to these chargrilled jumbo shrimps
Chimichanga - A crisp fried flour tortilla bursting with plenty of chicken, cheese and beans topped with sour cream and guacamole. Rice and Beans
Carnitas - Chargrilled chunks of marinated beef and pork served with warm tortillas,  Rice and Beans
Chicken Mole - Boneless breast of chicken topped with our own special mole sauce. Delicioso!!! Rice and Beans
Enchiladas Del Mar - Tender shrimps simmered in a creamy tomato sauce then rolled into soft corn tortillas, Rice and Beans
Enchilada Shortstack - A triple decker, open faced enchilada filled with chicken and cheese topped with enchilada sauce and melted cheese, Rice and Beans
Enchiladas Verdes - Soft corn tortillas filled with tender chicken then topped with a spicy green tomato sauce  Rice and Beans
